summary: In Mobile IPv4, a roaming device registers through whatever foreign network it is visiting, yet its basic host configuration should come from its home network. This informational document describes Cisco vendor-specific extensions to the Mobile IPv4 Registration Request and Reply messages that carry that base host configuration, such as a DNS server address.

eli5.summary: When you travel, you still want your home settings, like your usual phone book. This lets a roaming gadget get its settings from its home network instead of whatever place it is visiting.

questions: how does mobile ipv4 get a dns server address
